verdict.rationale: Godot has an official Asset Library (godot-docs-11/31) offering plugins, tools, scripts, templates, and demos, and an extensible plugin/import-plugin system (godot-docs-4,13,21) that lets third parties build tools. However, there is no evidence of scale/quality comparable to major store ecosystems (e.g., asset counts, marketplace revenue, curated 3D model catalogs), and community commentary notes maturity gaps in bindings/extensions (godot-comm-14). missing for 10: evidence of asset store size/breadth, third-party marketplace commerce, curated ready-made 3D models comparable to competitors, independent commentary on asset ecosystem quality.
